0.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_000
0.description: Do you require urgent assistance with an engineering matter? If not, I am afraid I must return to my work...
0.translation_description: Hai bisogno di assistenza urgente per una questione tecnica? Altrimenti, temo di dover tornare al mio lavoro...

1.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_Q1_000_000
1.description: What would you like to do?

3.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_A1_000_002
3.translation_description: Chiedi informazioni sul potenziamento della tavola magia.

5.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_010
5.description: I should be happy to augment your magia board, should you have the requisite materials in your possession. Do you...?
5.translation_description: Sarò lieto di potenziare la tua tavola magia, se hai con te i materiali necessari. Li hai?

6.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_020
6.description: Alas, it seems that you do not. A thousand pardons, but since I have no stock myself, I cannot assist you at this time.
6.translation_description: Purtroppo, sembra di no. Ti chiedo scusa, ma non ho scorte e al momento non posso aiutarti.

7.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_SYSTEM_000_021
7.description: In order to augment your magia board, you must possess <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDD020203>, <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDE020203>, and <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDF020203>.
7.translation_description: Per potenziare la tavola magia devi avere <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDD020203>, <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDE020203> e <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDF020203>.

8.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_030
8.description: Oh, so you do. Though, if I am to begin, you will of course need to give them over to me, if you would be so kind...
8.translation_description: Ah, quindi li hai. Però, per cominciare, dovrai consegnarmeli... se non ti dispiace.

9.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_031
9.description: Very good, very good. Now then, if you'll hand me your magia board, I'll get started right away. Rest assured this will only take a moment...
9.translation_description: Ottimo, ottimo. Ora, se mi consegni la tavola magia, comincerò subito. Non ci vorrà molto...

10.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_032
10.description: 'Tis done! I present to you your magia board, along with a sixth magicite, which you may now affix to it if you so desire.
10.translation_description: Fatto! Ecco la tua tavola magia e una sesta magicite, che potrai aggiungere se lo desideri.

11.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_033
11.description: Do bear in mind, however, that you may still only use up to five magicite to strengthen your affinity with a given element.
11.translation_description: Tieni presente, però, che puoi usare al massimo cinque magicite per rafforzare la tua affinità con ciascun elemento.

12.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_034
12.description: This limitation is due to the design of the magia board itself, I'm afraid. Short of rebuilding it from scratch, I don't see how it might be exceeded...
12.translation_description: Purtroppo, questo limite dipende dalla struttura stessa della tavola magia. Non vedo come superarlo, a meno di ricostruirla da zero...

18.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_040
18.description: We've devised a simple method by which an additional sixth magicite can be safely affixed to your magia board. Surely I needn't explain the advantages of being able to do so!
18.translation_description: Abbiamo ideato un metodo semplice per aggiungere in sicurezza una sesta magicite alla tua tavola magia. Non c’è bisogno che ti spieghi i vantaggi!

19.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_SYSTEM_000_041
19.description: Through magia board augmentation, you can increase the maximum number of magicite which can be affixed to it.
19.translation_description: Potenziare la tavola magia aumenta il numero massimo di magicite che puoi aggiungervi.

20.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_050
20.description: The augmentation procedure is not terribly difficult in of itself, but it does require a number of resources that I do not have at present. I'm afraid you'll have to go and procure them yourself.
20.translation_description: La procedura in sé non è particolarmente difficile, ma richiede parecchie risorse che al momento non ho. Temo che dovrai procurartene da solo.

21.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_SYSTEM_000_051
21.description: In order to augment your magia board, you must possess <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDD020203>, <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDE020203>, and <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDF020203>.
21.translation_description: Per potenziare la tavola magia devi avere <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDD020203>, <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDE020203> e <hex:02310DFF054974656D02F25EDF020203>.

22.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_060
22.description: I have an extra magicite I can give to you once I've finished augmenting your magia board. It's actually one of the depleted magicite that you recovered in Pagos that we performed a number of experiments on. Functionally, it is now no different from the others you use in conjunction with your board.
22.translation_description: Dopo aver potenziato la tavola magia, potrò darti una magicite extra. È una delle magicite esauste che hai recuperato a Pagos e sulle quali abbiamo condotto diversi esperimenti. Ora funziona come le altre che usi insieme alla tavola.

23.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_SYSTEM_000_061
23.description: The sixth magicite that you may affix to an augmented magia board is functionally the same as the other five and confers no additional benefits.
23.translation_description: La sesta magicite che puoi aggiungere alla tavola potenziata funziona come le altre cinque e non offre vantaggi ulteriori.

24.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_SYSTEM_000_062
24.description: However, due to the design of the magia board, you may use no more than five to strengthen your affinity with a given element.
24.translation_description: Tuttavia, per via della struttura della tavola magia, puoi usarne al massimo cinque per rafforzare la tua affinità con ciascun elemento.

25.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3SUBSPHEREGUIDE_00533_ENG00465_000_070
25.description: I hope the augmented magia board is to your liking. So you know, Gerolt and I are not content to rest on our laurels and are still discussing what other improvements we could potentially make. Should we conceive of other ways in which we might augment it further, we will let you know immediately.
25.translation_description: Spero che la tavola magia potenziata ti soddisfi. Sappi che Gerolt e io non ci accontentiamo dei risultati raggiunti: stiamo già discutendo di altri possibili miglioramenti. Se troveremo altri modi per potenziarla, te lo faremo sapere subito.
